text:
olivia: deploy-bot flagged eu-dedicated canary p95 +190ms and small error uptick during change window.

deploy-bot: alert: canary.p95=665ms (+190) over 7m; client_err_rate +1.6%. Suggested: PAUSE rollout and run probe. auto-rollback: disabled (change-window tag).

dan: Which commit in this rollout touched runtime/kernel? We had a selector tweak and a telemetry client bump.

trent: Selector tweak (kernel routing) + perf lint fix. Local bench OK but no multi-az.

ops_oncall: With auto-rollback off we need to pick: manual full rollback, split traffic, or targeted kernel revert. I prefer split 50/50 to reduce blast radius and keep canary for debugging.

olivia: Agreed. Also loop in legal for any customers on early access.

deploy-bot: helper commands:
- split 50/50: `redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --route default --split 50:50 --to v2.3.9,v2.4.3`
- pin canary: `redwood pin --instance canary-eu --version v2.4.3`
- rollback pool: `redwood rollback --pool eu-dedicated --to v2.3.9`

trent: I'll open a cherry-pick revert PR for the kernel selector in parallel.

olivia: @legal please review customer comm blurb before we send to early-access list.

legal: quick ack. fine with generic wording: no data loss, we are mitigating. No promises about SLA changes in thread.

ops_oncall: proceeding with 50/50 split. @trent apply and post monitor link.

trent: executing: `redwood traffic set --pool eu-dedicated --split 50:50 --to v2.3.9,v2.4.3` now.

deploy-bot: action started (rollout id: r-618888-01). Requested by trent.

trent: applied. monitor: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/eu-dedicated/r-618888-01

10m update - trent: overall p95 down to 505ms; v2.3.9 ~495ms; v2.4.3 ~665ms.

dan: signal concentrated on v2.4.3. Cherry-pick revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4501. CI queued.

olivia: Send customer note to early-access list: short, link to monitor, contact ops_oncall.

legal: approved note.

ops_oncall: Notified CS and SRE rotations: `@cs-eu` `@sre-oncall`. Keeping 50/50 split for 30m, will escalate to full rollback if metrics don't improve after revert.

trent: PR merged and canary redeploy scheduled; health-checks will gate promotion. auto-rollback still suppressed.

20m: trent: post-merge canary p95 back to ~480ms, errors normalized. Keeping split for one more hour while we run soak.

olivia: update release notes with entry: "temporarily disabled kernel-selector toggle pending additional perf validation" and add perf checklist to PR.

dan: will follow up on longer-term perf regression tests before next rollout.

ops_oncall: closing active rollback decision thread; reopen if regressions recur. :thumbsup:
